meta.scope: Mexico batch 2 — foundational legal instrument + core price and national-accounts series + employment. New broader node definition (static + recurring citation).
meta.format_note: Candidates shaped to map cleanly to project Report type (id, title, publisher, country, jurisdiction_level, region, description, releases_per_year, url, domains) plus evidence notes with contextual quotes.

candidates.title: Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (LSNIEG)
candidates.publisher: Congreso de la Unión / Estados Unidos Mexicanos
candidates.description: Foundational 2008 statute (last major reform DOF 14-11-2025) that creates the autonomous INEGI and the entire Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (SNIEG). Regulates Information of National Interest, the rights/obligations of informants, and INEGI’s organisation and powers. Static instrument with no independent publication cadence of its own.
referenced_by: mx-inpc (legal authority for price indices transferred to INEGI)
Norma Técnica para la Generación de Estadística Básica and many SNIEG technical norms
candidates.notes:
Classic pure recurring-citation node under the new rule. Every major INEGI methodology synthesis opens by grounding itself in this Law.

Contextual quote from Censo Agropecuario 2022 methodology (INEGI):
"El Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI), con el propósito de ofrecer estadísticas actuales, completas y oportunas de las actividades agropecuarias y forestales en México y con fundamento en las atribuciones que le confiere la Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (LSNIEG), realizó el Censo Agropecuario 2022. El presente documento es una síntesis metodológica que da sustento y transparencia a los procedimientos conceptuales, operativos, de procesamiento, análisis de datos y difusión de resultados..."

Contextual quote from Censo de Población y Vivienda 2010 Síntesis metodológica:
"El Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI), con fundamento en lo dispuesto por la Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos en su Artículo 26, apartado B, y en el ejercicio de las atribuciones que la Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica le confiere, realizó el Censo de Población y Vivienda 2010. ... Bases legales. Para la generación de información estadística y geográfica, el INEGI se rige por lo dispuesto en la Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (Ley del SNIEG) que tiene fundamento en lo dispuesto en el artículo 26, apartado B de la Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos."

The Law itself states (Art. 1): it is of public order, social interest and general observance throughout the Republic, and has as its object the regulation of the SNIEG, the rights and obligations of Informants, the organisation and functioning of INEGI, and administrative offences.

candidates.title: Índice Nacional de Precios al Consumidor (INPC) / Consumer Price Index
candidates.description: Primary consumer price index. Base second half of July 2018 = 100. Basket and weights updated 2024 using ENIGH 2022 Seasonal while preserving the base via chaining. Published twice monthly (around the 10th and 25th) in the Official Journal of the Federation. Transferred from Banco de México to INEGI under the LSNIEG effective July 2011.
candidates.notes:
High-frequency, high-authority series. Legal transfer is explicitly documented.

Contextual quote from INEGI INPC programme page:
"From its beginnings until June 2011, the Price Indexes were calculated by Mexico's Central Bank, however, with the entry into force of the Law of the National System of Statistical and Geographical Information, the exclusive power for the elaboration of these macroeconomic indicators was granted to the National Institute of Statistics and Geography (INEGI), so that as of July 15th, 2011, the Institute periodically and systematically quotes, analyzes, calculates and publishes the CPI and PPI indexes."

Publication practice: "The CPI is published on the 10th and 25th of each month in the Official Journal of the Federation, or on the previous working day in case these dates are Saturday, Sunday or holiday. On the 25th of the month, the calculation of the first half of the month is published, on the 10th, the one corresponding to the monthly data and the second half of the previous month is published."

candidates.title: Índice Nacional de Precios Productor (INPP) / Producer Price Index
candidates.description: National producer price index. Base July 2019. Covers production for domestic consumption and export (with and without oil). Same legal transfer from Banco de México to INEGI under LSNIEG as the INPC. Monthly publication.
candidates.notes: Companion series to INPC. Shares the same 2011 legal transfer. Recent releases (e.g. July 2026) are published on the INEGI site with annual percentage changes. Used as an input into national-accounts deflation and other price analyses.

candidates.title: Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México (SCNM) / System of National Accounts of Mexico
candidates.description: Mexico’s integrated national accounts framework following SNA 2008. Includes annual and quarterly estimates, Supply and Use Tables, institutional sector accounts, satellite accounts (culture, health, non-profit, unpaid household work, tourism, etc.), and related short-term indicators. Current major base years include 2018 and earlier 2013/2008 benchmarks.
candidates.notes:
Central macroeconomic framework. Explicitly adopts SNA 2008.

Contextual material from INEGI methodology documents (SCNM base 2008 series): the calculations adopt and adapt the conceptual and accounting framework of the System of National Accounts approved by the United Nations Statistical Commission for 1968, 1993 and 2008, together with specific manuals. Annual calculations with base year 2008 produce the current and accumulation accounts recommended by SNA 2008 (goods and services accounts, institutional sector accounts, public-sector macroeconomic indicators, etc.).

IMF ROSC (2021) confirms: "The methodology followed is consistent with the System of National Accounts 2008 and the IMF’s Quarterly National Accounts Manual 2017."

candidates.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
candidates.description: Decennial population and housing census (years ending in 0). Most complete basic source for demographic and social data. Intermediate counts (1995, 2005) and intercensal surveys have also been conducted. Explicitly declared Information of National Interest under the LSNIEG.
candidates.notes:
High-authority, low-frequency node. Legal grounding is standard across census methodology documents.

Contextual quote (Censo 2010 Síntesis metodológica):
"El Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI), con fundamento en lo dispuesto por la Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos en su Artículo 26, apartado B, y en el ejercicio de las atribuciones que la Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica le confiere, realizó el Censo de Población y Vivienda 2010. ... en la mencionada ley se declara que la información de los censos nacionales es de interés nacional, por lo que en su artículo 59 confiere al INEGI la realización de los mismos."

candidates.title: Censos Económicos / Economic Censuses
candidates.description: Conducted every five years since 1930. Comprehensive data on economic units in fishing, mining, electricity/water/gas, construction, manufacturing, trade, services and transport. Principal structural input for national-accounts benchmarks and base-year changes.
candidates.notes: Key structural source. Periodicity is fixed at five years; the 2024 census refers to activity in calendar year 2023. Used extensively in SCNM base-year revisions and informal-sector measurement (together with ENOE).

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional de Ocupación y Empleo (ENOE) / National Survey of Occupation and Employment
candidates.description: Primary continuous labour-force survey. Provides unemployment rate, participation rate, employment by industry and many sociodemographic labour variables at national, state and selected city levels. Quarterly results form part of the permanent programme.
candidates.notes: Core labour series. Documented downstream use in national accounts for informal-sector estimates (IMF ROSC notes ENOE together with Economic Censuses). Programme description emphasises national, state and city coverage for labour-force and occupational characteristics.

proposed_edges.basis: Legal authority for production of the CPI transferred to INEGI by the LSNIEG (effective July 2011).
Same LSNIEG transfer that moved both CPI and PPI production to INEGI.
National accounts form part of Información de Interés Nacional defined and regulated by the Law (Art. 59 / 78).
Methodology documents state adoption and adaptation of SNA 2008; IMF ROSC confirms consistency with SNA 2008.
Census methodology explicitly cites LSNIEG Art. 59 as conferring exclusive faculty on INEGI to conduct national censuses.
Economic Censuses supply detailed structural data used for national-accounts benchmarks and base-year changes; also used with ENOE for informal-sector measurement.
proposed_edges.reference_period: every five years / at each base-year revision

proposed_edges.basis: IMF ROSC notes use of ENOE (with Economic Censuses) for informal-sector measurement in the SCNM.
